text: ① 15:00 欧洲央行管委兼法国央行行长Emmanuel Moulin在金融科技论坛讲话； ② 15:30 欧洲央行执委Cipollone在一场关于数字货币、支付、储备管理的地中海周边央行会议上讲话； ③ 17:00 欧元区9月CPI初值； ④ 19:30 欧洲央行副主席Boris Vujcic在法兰克福讲话； ⑤ 20:30 美国9月非农就业报告（含就业人口、失业率、平均每小时工资等）； ⑥ 22:00 美国8月耐用品订单终值、工厂订单，美国达拉斯联储主席洛根（Lorie Logan，2026年FOMC票委）在一个年度活动上致欢迎辞； ⑦ 次日03:
text_en: ① 15:00 ECB Governing Council member and Bank of France Governor Emmanuel Moulin speaks at a fintech forum; ② 15:30 ECB Executive Board member Cipollone speaks at a Mediterranean central bank conference on digital currencies, payments and reserve management; ③ 17:00 Eurozone September CPI preliminary reading; ④ 19:30 ECB Vice-President Boris Vujcic speaks in Frankfurt; ⑤ 20:30 US September nonfarm payrolls report (including employment, unemployment rate, average hourly earnings, etc.); ⑥ 22:00 US August durable goods orders final reading, factory orders; Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan (2026 FOMC voter) delivers welcome remarks at an annual event; ⑦ Next day 03:
